notes.title: Balance Patch #2
notes.notes:
Quality of Life updates:
    - The retry gate in the town square will now open for the 2D levels if you quit during them.
    - The 2D levels now have in-level checkpoints across all 3 maps.
    - Cossett boss fight now has a checkpoint after beating the head race / Indiana Jones phase.
    - Cossett boss fight now has a checkpoint at the beginning of the lava phase.
    - Carnage tracker now incrementally changes the color of the kill count skull to indicate the kill streak is ongoing.
    - Cannon Ultimate now adds +2 hit max
    - Icicle weapon now targets the closest enemy to the player on the first icicle.
    - Icicles now fall faster.
    - Changes to the Icicle fall patterns for less randomness.
    - Dishes required to be washed for tutorial now takes into account new combo system and is accurate to the "dishes washed this combo" number.

  Bug Fixes:
    - Fixes an issue with the Pigeon Potion VFX not scaling correctly with the actual radius of the explosion.
    - Fixes audio issues in the 2D scenes. All audios should now be affected by volume controls.
    - Fixes a bug in the tutorial where the player could be soft locked by crafting the pants before buying the ingredients from the merchant.
    - Fixes a bug in the Cossett head race section where the head would sometimes respawn randomly.

  Still being worked on:
    - Audio issue with the rotating letters on the Tim boss fight.
    - Being able to initiate a dash while the inventory is open.

notes.title: Hotfix #15
notes.notes:
- Tweaks the latest dishwashing combo changes to increase the speed of the skill check pin as the combo increases. The new speed will be proportionate to the combo multiplier between 1 and 10,000. At combo 1, the duration of the pin is 1 second. At combo 10,000 the duration is 0.4 seconds. This scales linearly between the two.

- Gold per wash is now capped at 50g to maintain a reasonable economy.

Dev Note: To avoid snowballing exponential returns the minigame will now scale in difficulty as the combo increases.

notes.title: Hotfix #14
notes.notes:
- Updates the combo system to make the dishwashing minigame achievements more attainable. The new system introduces exponential increases in the combo multiplier for streaks with longer combos.
     - Every 5 dishes perfectly washed in a row will grant an increase in the combo multiplier.
     - Every 25 dishes perfectly washed in a row will double the amount added to the combo multiplier after 5 perfectly washed dishes.
     - Gold for plates washed is capped at 100g per wash

- Fixes issue with credits showing after finishing on some aspect ratios

Dev Notes: This new dishwashing combo system is exponential in nature, meaning that it is still hard to get very high combos because it requires large amounts of perfect washes. But if you are able to get high amounts of perfect washes in a row, your payoff increases exponentially as you progress. Gold from the minigame is now capped at 100 gold per wash to account for the potential exponential increases.

notes.title: Content Patch #1
notes.notes:
- Due to massively popular demand we have added new achievements for dishwashing (all the way up to 1 million dishes washed)
- Along with these new achievements comes a new COMBO mechanic for the dishwashing. The more plates you can wash skillfully, the higher your combo and the more dishes and gold you earn per wash. This can now be a good way to earn gold if you're skilled.

This patch also has a few bug fixes:
- Fixes feedback weapon stalling out in certain situations
- Fixes an issue where the player could be stuck inside the miniboss arena barrier

notes.title: Balance Patch #1
notes.notes:
- Easy mode has been adjusted to be even easier for many parts of the game.

	This includes:
		- Enemy health is now 50% of Normal mode enemy health instead of 70%
		- Player health on boss fights now 300% of Normal mode player health
		- Word minigame now has 6 Re-Rolls instead of 3
		- Ball Climb minigame now only requires hole 3 instead of hole 4 to win

- Normal mode as been adjusted to be slightly easier on the Ball Climb minigame (Requires hole 5 instead of hole 6 to win)

- Word minigame now shows Tips after certain period of time

- UI scaling has been adjusted for ultra-wide monitors on all UI in the Town Square

- Added option to press 'E' to skip dialogue

- Adjusted 'Empty' inventory gear slot icons to make empty slots more obvious
